title: The Unwelcome Crossing
project: a separate project outside the skill: a haunted desert crossing, cinematic, with object-based delivery
brief: an unwelcoming desert with no path to survive: Arabian instruments only, plus piano, violin and flutes, Zimmer pulse and Rahman layering, a haunted desert air with natural sand SFX
audience: a player or listener in a 7.1.2 room or on headphones, with the cue looping under gameplay
purpose: make the desert feel like it is taking the travellers: no path, no water, no way back
point_of_view: the listener is one of the travellers on foot, never able to see where the route is
job: put the listener on foot in a desert that gives nothing back
keep a pulse under the fear without turning it into an action cue
let the dune itself make the loudest sound in the piece
end with no resolution, because there is no path out
story: the last water is drunk at a cistern at dusk; the caravan walks out and the trail erases behind them; the dunes start to boom and the sand moves without wind; jackals answer from three bearings; by the last section there is no water, no landmark and no route, and the piece simply stops being able to go on

sections.name: cistern
sections.action: the last water at dusk: no landmark, nothing growing
sections.music: oud alone states the trail figure; piano sets the clock, flute hangs above; no drum

sections.name: no_road
sections.action: the caravan leaves the cistern and the trail erases itself behind them
sections.music: darbuka enters on a saidi 4/4 with a new fill each bar; ney takes the figure; qanun runs 16ths; violin holds a moving texture

sections.name: the_moan
sections.action: the dunes begin to boom; the sand moves without wind
sections.music: drums out; a 78 Hz dune swell from the air bed, piano clusters, one long ney cry, violin high

sections.name: jackals
sections.action: they are answered from three bearings and keep walking
sections.music: piano pulse to 16ths, qanun turns to 16ths, darbuka double-times into the last bar; jackal answers far away

sections.name: no_water
sections.action: nothing left to drink, no path out; the piece does not resolve
sections.music: everything thins to rababa, low piano, a last ney phrase that ends on the fifth; one dune slump; fade

motifs.name: the trail figure
motifs.shape: D-Eb(+50c)-F-G, the half-flat second never resolving upward
motifs.returns: oud every bar in a new transposition, ney in augmentation, and as the last phrase over the fifth

motifs.name: the dune's answer
motifs.shape: a 78 Hz swell with its harmonics, no rhythm
motifs.returns: at the moan and again when the water runs out

motifs.name: the jackal
motifs.shape: two or three rising howls that sag, answered by a thinner one
motifs.returns: behind and to the right, from a different bearing each bout

avoid_sounds: any chant treated as a sample drop
pulse: steady low piano pulse, 8ths then 16ths, never on the melody

hits.sound: a sheet of sand lifting off hardpan as the darbuka enters
hits.why: the moment the trail stops existing

hits.sound: the dune's slip face giving way under the 78 Hz bed
hits.why: the desert becomes a character here, not scenery

hits.sound: a far jackal answering the sand
hits.why: something else is out here, and it is not lost

must_hear: the 78 Hz dune swell arriving under the piano cluster
the sand blast at the moment the trail erases
the last ney phrase ending on the fifth, not the tonic

delivery.note: two-channel first, a 48 kHz twin for engine ingest, the 7.1.2 and 7.1 scenes, and adm_bw64 objects so the cue can be placed rather than just played

references: an oud recorded close in a dry room; a piano felt-muted and close; a violin held long with no per-note vibrato
desert air after the last water: a 70-105 Hz dune pressure, sand hiss at 0.8-2.5 kHz, gusts that start and stop, jackals far off
gate_reason: a cue that ends with nothing resolved, so the tense profile judges it: unresolved harmony and a held pressure are the design, not defects; melody, ostinato and drone all carry it

immersive.why: the sand arrives from every bearing and the dune is under and around the listener; that surround field is the story, not decoration

movers.why: the only thing that drifts: air moving where nothing else does
movers.path: hangs front-right and high through the crossing, drifts overhead at the jackals, settles back right at the end

must_hear: the dune swell from below and behind
the sand blast sweeping across the back
the jackal answering from the right rear
immersive.notes: every height is inside the mix's 35 degree ceiling; bass and drum stay on the floor

notes: No SFZ library for these instruments is in the skill registry and sfizz cannot run on this host, so every part plays the GM bank through project presets; the SFZ block is left out rather than faked. The ambience is preset data: one environment and two one-hit SFX, each citing the research note.
